title: Airbnb’s latest update brings AI search, easier property comparisons, and more services
key_facts: Airbnb added AI search for homes, experiences and services, by text or voice.
AI suggests filters from a keyword; searching "baby" can surface cribs and toys.
AI highlights key features in search results.
AI customer support chat in more than 50 languages; voice support by phone coming.
From November, baby gear rental via BabyQuip in more than 60 US cities; laundry via Rinse in select US cities; grocery and meal delivery expanding to Europe.
Builds on a redesigned iOS and Android app.
quote_evidence: Like Claude or ChatGPT, Airbnb's new AI search lets you type or speak a query
Airbnb is also expanding its AI-powered customer support, with chat available in more than 50 languages, and voice support over the phone on the way.
why_it_matters_hint: Large consumer apps are making AI the default way to search.
